definitions.explanation: The act of moving or carrying goods, materials, or cargo from one place to another.

examples.japanese: {荷物|にもつ}を{運搬|うんぱん}する。
{運搬|うんぱん}{費用|ひよう}が{高|たか}い。
{土砂|どしゃ}の{運搬|うんぱん}にトラックを{使|つか}う。
examples.english: We use trucks to transport soil and sand.

notes:
{運搬|うんぱん} refers to moving goods or materials from one place to another.

WORD COMPOSITION:
- {運|うん}: carry, transport
- {搬|ぱん}: convey, carry

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {運搬|うんぱん}する: to transport, to convey
- {運搬|うんぱん}{費用|ひよう}/{運搬|うんぱん}{費|ひ}: transportation cost
- {運搬|うんぱん}{車|しゃ}: transport vehicle
- {運搬|うんぱん}{業者|ぎょうしゃ}: transport company, carrier
- {運搬|うんぱん}{作業|さぎょう}: transport work

RELATED TERMS:
- {輸送|ゆそう}: transportation (more formal, larger scale)
- {配送|はいそう}: delivery
- {運送|うんそう}: shipping, freight
